title: pinus laricio subsp. pallasiana
intro: Pinus laricio subsp. pallasiana, commonly known as Pallas's or Calabrian pine, is a subspecies of evergreen tree belonging to the Pinaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its resin has been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pinus laricio subsp. pallasiana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which may help to soothe respiratory issues, wounds, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including expectorant, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects.
